summaries.Oral reading: Read aloud in the printed order. Pronounce words clearly and pause at punctuation. Teachers assess accuracy and fluency; the printed text is the oral response.
summaries.Subject and verb: Use sentence meaning, subject agreement and time clues to choose the word or verb form. Apply the specific rule explained for each task and note ambiguous choices.
summaries.Opposites: Choose the meaning required by the sentence, then give the corresponding opposite or counterpart. Keep the same grammatical form.
summaries.Spelling: Use sentence meaning, subject agreement and time clues to choose the word or verb form. Apply the specific rule explained for each task and note ambiguous choices.
summaries.Comprehension: Find evidence in the passage or poem before answering. Distinguish explicit statements, reasonable inferences and model interpretations.
summaries.Source-limited items: The required script, picture or other information is missing. Use the stated limitation and obtain the original material before expecting a unique answer.
summaries.Vocabulary and grammar: Use sentence meaning, subject agreement and time clues to choose the word or verb form. Apply the specific rule explained for each task and note ambiguous choices.
summaries.Present continuous: Use sentence meaning, subject agreement and time clues to choose the word or verb form. Apply the specific rule explained for each task and note ambiguous choices.
summaries.Punctuation: Statements end with full stops and questions with question marks. Use commas for list items and exclamation marks where strong feeling is expressed.
summaries.Picture vocabulary: Observe the pictured object or action. Name its identifying features and use correct spelling; action sentences use is or are with an ing verb.
